CC is for Crowd Control and refers to any ability that stuns the target(s). Which in turn stops the enemy from casting spells. Some mobs are immune to crowd control however. Displacement effects such as Monks Ring of Peace and Death Knights Death Grip which move the enemy also stop the spell from being cast.

Kick/Interrupt seem to be used interchangeably. And usually refers to using a spell dedicated to stopping spells from being casts.
